correctness.rationale: Necklaces are binary length-10 words modulo rotation, with adjacency iff a single bit changes after choosing rotations. Complete orbit enumeration/Burnside gives 108 necklaces, 56 even-weight and 52 odd-weight. Single-bit adjacency is bipartite and any simple path has at most 52 odd and 53 even vertices, hence at most 105. The actual CERTIFICATE.txt has 105 pairwise distinct canonical representatives, and 104 successive pairs have Hamming-one representatives. Complete independent checks of all 1024 words and the certificate verify the finite lower bound; combined with the parity inequality this proves exact longest path 105 vertices (104 edges), without assuming a heuristic solver is exhaustive.
residual_risks: Finite experiments do not prove unrestricted statements; proof deductions above carry general assertion.

Mütze’s 2023 survey states the even-order balancedness obstruction to Hamiltonian 1-Gray codes; Degni–Drisko’s earlier Gray orders and 2008 n=9 construction address different settings. No inspected primary passage supplied the exact order-ten 105-vertex witness. PASS best-of-knowledge with incomplete primary 2016 full-text and hidden-equivalent-path risks.
